content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit _ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https"} def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() safe_text = html.escape(name, quote=True) # Only allow safe URL schemes to avoid javascript:, data:, etc. # Reject control characters/whitespace inside the URL that browsers may strip. safe_url = "" if url and not any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in url): try: parts = urlsplit(url) except ValueError: parts = None if parts is not None and parts.scheme.lower() in _ALLOWED_SCHEMES and parts.netloc: safe_url = url if not safe_url: return safe_text safe_href = html.escape(safe_url, quote=True) return f'{safe_text}'
